Name: Lnh's Community Center Expanded
Author: liunianhui
Description:
[center][color=#ffff00][size=4]接受地图绘制委托，如果你正在制作mod，需要找人绘制地图，那么请联系我。
Accept the commission of map drawing. If you are making mod and need to find someone to draw a map, please contact me.[/size][/color]

[color=#ff00ff][size=5]社区中心扩大(Community Center Expanded)[/size]
[size=4]这个mod修改了社区中心地图，使它变的更大，它可以是一个温室，也可以是一个棚屋，还可以当做酒窖来使用，你需要给祝尼魔提供食物，让它们帮助你解锁更多区域。每次解锁一块区域，你都会获得奖励，奖励来自祝尼魔。

This mod modified the map of the community center to make it larger. It can be a greenhouse, a shed, or a cellar. You need to provide food to Junimos and they will help you to unlock more rooms. Every time you unlock a new room, you'll also get rewards from the Junimos.[/size][/color]

[color=#00ff00][size=5]注意事项：[/size]
[size=4]这个mod需要一个依赖项mod，[/size][/color][color=#00ff00][size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17265]Unlockable Bundles[/url] ，你需要安装它。
﻿只有当你完成社区中心献祭之后这个mod才会起作用。(joja超市路线是无效的)
可以在你的旧存档中使用

This mod requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17265]Unlockable Bundles[/url] .﻿
The content of this mod will only be available after you have completed the community center bundles. (hence not applicable for joja route)
Can be used in an existing save.[/size][/color]
